title: no tooltip with actual values, values not shown anywhere
line: System Monitor widgets now show their sensors' current values in the tooltip, also right after being added.
explanation: The tooltip only listed the total sensor, so presets without one (Network Speed, Disk Activity) and the individual sensors in a chart were never shown with their values. On top of that, the applet's faceController property was CONSTANT but is only created in init(), which for a freshly added widget runs after main.qml is loaded, so the title and total-sensor bindings stayed on 'System Monitor' with no value until plasmashell restarted. The tooltip now lists the total sensor plus the high-priority sensors (custom labels respected, duplicates skipped, at most 8 since the tooltip shows 8 lines), and faceController gets a change signal emitted from init().

commits.message:
applets/systemmonitor: show sensor values in the tooltip

The tooltip only showed the total sensor, so widgets without one never
showed a value, and new widgets showed nothing until a restart. Also
list the high-priority sensors and signal when the controller is set.

BUG: 445570

media.caption: Memory Usage widget just added to the panel: tooltip says only 'System Monitor'
Memory Usage just added: tooltip shows the preset title, used percentage and used memory
Network Speed widget: no values in the tooltip
Network Speed: download and upload rates in the tooltip
Individual Core Usage bars: no values, bars have no labels
Individual Core Usage: total plus per-core values

review.text: Both causes are real and both are fixed: the tooltip only listed the total sensor, and faceController was a CONSTANT property even though it is created in init(), so new widgets bound to null. Making it NOTIFY is the right fix. Listing the high-priority sensors with their custom labels is simple. The cap of 8 matches DefaultToolTip's line limit, though it is a slightly magic number. The extra Sensor objects keep subscriptions open while the tooltip is hidden, but they are sensors the face already shows. The three before/after pairs show the bug and the fix clearly.
